back: Close together, regular pattern, vibrate about fixed positions; strong forces.
Close together, irregular, slide past each other.
Far apart, random arrangement, move fast in all directions; very weak forces.

front: How is temperature related to particles?
back: Higher temperature = higher average kinetic energy of the particles.
−273 °C (0 K): the lowest possible temperature; particles have least kinetic energy.
Random jerky motion of microscopic particles (smoke, pollen) caused by collisions with fluid molecules.
Spreading of particles from high to low concentration by random motion.
